note: 神态表情编号库。工牌场景的微笑幅度必须可控，批量出图时同一岗位锁定同一编号。

moods.desc_zh: 嘴唇自然闭合，眼周放松，目光稳定不游移
moods.desc_en: Lips naturally closed, relaxed eye area, steady gaze
moods.prompt_zh: 表情平静专注，嘴唇自然闭合，目光稳定落在镜头上
moods.prompt_en: calm focused expression, lips naturally closed, gaze steady on the lens

moods.desc_zh: 嘴角上提 15 度以内，不露或微露齿，苹果肌自然发力
moods.desc_en: Mouth corners raised under 15 degrees, teeth none or barely, genuine cheek lift
moods.prompt_zh: 亲和的浅笑，嘴角轻微上提、不刻意露齿，眼神同时变暖
moods.prompt_en: approachable light smile, mouth corners gently raised without forced teeth, eyes warming in sync

moods.desc_zh: 眉眼舒展，笑意很浅但持续，注视不带催促感
moods.desc_en: Soft brows, faint sustained smile, unhurried attention
moods.prompt_zh: 温和耐心的神态，眉眼完全舒展，微笑幅度很小但真实
moods.prompt_en: gentle patient demeanor, brows fully relaxed, a very small but genuine smile

moods.desc_zh: 面部肌肉整体放松但下颌明确，注视时长略增
moods.desc_en: Relaxed face with a defined jawline, slightly sustained eye contact
moods.prompt_zh: 沉稳权威的神态，面部松弛但下颌线明确，注视稳定不回避
moods.prompt_en: grounded authoritative demeanor, relaxed face with a clear jawline, sustained unavoiding eye contact

moods.desc_zh: 情绪幅度压到最低，适合技术与财务岗
moods.desc_en: Emotion held to a minimum; suits engineering and finance
moods.prompt_zh: 内敛克制的神态，表情几乎无起伏，目光安静而聚焦
moods.prompt_en: reserved restrained expression, near-flat affect, quiet focused eyes

moods.desc_zh: 眉尾轻微上挑，笑意明确，眼神先一步打招呼
moods.desc_en: Slight brow lift, clear smile, eyes greeting first
moods.prompt_zh: 明快主动的神态，眉尾轻微上挑，笑意明确但不夸张
moods.prompt_en: bright proactive demeanor, brows lifting slightly, a clear but never exaggerated smile

moods.desc_zh: 证件与签证级中性表情，禁止微笑
moods.desc_en: ID and visa grade neutral expression, no smiling allowed
moods.prompt_zh: 严谨中性的面部状态，双唇闭合、肌肉完全放松、无任何笑意
moods.prompt_en: strictly neutral facial state, lips sealed, muscles fully relaxed, no trace of a smile
moods.compliance_note: 多数国家签证照要求中性表情且双眼睁开，不得露齿笑

moods.desc_zh: 肩线与面部同时松下来，笑或不笑都可以
moods.desc_en: Shoulders and face both released; smile optional
moods.prompt_zh: 自信松弛的神态，面部与肩颈同时放松，不刻意摆拍也不紧绷
moods.prompt_en: confident easy demeanor, face and shoulders released together, neither posed nor tense
